finalText:
Confirmed enough to sign off.

**~94 files touch `account_id`**, across accounts/orders/billing/notify/analytics services plus migrations and docs. Real work but mechanical — mostly repo/service/route params.

Two places must not be renamed:

1. `[lib/serialize.js:8](lib/serialize.js:8)` — the wire key is explicitly frozen, it's the public API contract documented in `docs/openapi.yaml`. Rename the internal column, keep the wire-side mapping as `account_id`.
2. `vendor/reporting-sdk/**` (4 files) — vendored/generated, header says "Do not edit... overwritten by `npm run vendor:refresh`". Any `account_id` there is a separate upstream concern.

Also flag: `migrations/*.sql` are historical, already-applied migrations — don't edit them, add a new `ALTER TABLE ... RENAME COLUMN` migration instead. `lib/audit.js` writes `account_id` into audit log lines; worth confirming with whoever reads those logs before renaming the key, since old log lines will still say `account_id`.

Net: safe to approve renaming internal DB columns and code, as long as the public JSON field, the vendor SDK, and old migration files stay untouched.
